_what: Documents as rows (document-properties.mjs): a folder of a person's text documents read as a list's rows, each with its own properties (written in the document itself, as frontmatter), what the file is (name, folder, times, size, links, backlinks, tags) and formulas worked out from both. A list names the folder with row_sources [{ source: <source>, of: <folder> }]; a saved view names a value by its namespace and key (note.status, file.mtime, formula.late). The kinds of property, the file facts, the link and tag syntaxes, the refusal words and every bound are rows here; the code names none of them.
_source: The row source name a list uses for a folder of documents.
_namespaces: The namespace each kind of value is named in: a document's own properties, the facts of its file, the folder's formulas (the same names as the list's source_namespaces.documents).
_sidecar_name: The one small file, at the top of the folder a list reads, that says each property's kind and the folder's formulas: { types: { <property>: <field kind> }, formulas: { <name>: <formula-engine binding> } }. Without it every property is text and there are no formulas.
_property_kinds: The list field kinds a property may have. Computed and rule kinds are not properties: a formula is one of the folder's formulas.
_kind_values: The shape each property kind keeps its value in (a list field kind's `value`): text, number, or texts (a list of texts).
_tag_keys: Property keys read as the document's tags and aliases, compared without case (Obsidian's tags/aliases convention).
_file_facts: The file.* values of every document: key is the name a view uses (file.<key>), kind its list field kind, from the fact it is read from (a listing column, a part of its name, or what its words link to). backlinks are worked out only when a read asks for them.
_links: How a document's words link to another document: a regular expression whose first group is the target, resolved by name (a document's name without its folder or extension, as [[Weekly review]]) or by path (a name starting with / or relative to the document's folder, as [notes](../plan.md)). Web addresses (with a scheme) are not documents and are left out. embed says whether it is shown inside the document (file.embeds) rather than linked (file.links).
_inline_tag: A tag written in the words (#project/alpha); its first group is the tag. Tags are kept without their #.
_limits: write_attempts: how many times a property change is made again on a document that changed meanwhile (each time on what it now says, so the other change is kept). page_rows: the rows one read answers when it names no limit; page_rows_most: the most it may ask for (a folder of any size is read a page at a time). bytes_per_document: the most of a document read for its properties and links.

refusals.bad_document_types: A folder's property types are { types: { <property>: one of {kinds} }, formulas: { <name>: { binding: <formula>, kind? } } } with at most {formulas} formulas; {what} is not.
refusals.formula_cycle: The formula {formula} reads itself through {through}, so working it out would never end.
refusals.bad_document_property: A document's own properties are written as {properties}.<key> (a key of letters, digits, - and _); {what} cannot be written: file facts and formulas are worked out, and a document is removed as a file.
refusals.bad_property_value: The property {property} of {document} is a {kind}, and {value} is not one.
refusals.document_changed: The document {document} changed after it was read ({expected} is now {current}); read it again and make the change on what it says now.
refusals.not_a_document: {document} is not a text document in this folder.
refusals.bad_page: A page of rows holds 1 to {most} rows.
